title: Structural, spectroscopic, in silico, in vitro and DNA binding evaluations of tyrosyl-lysyl-threonine.
authors: Bicak, Bilge; Kecel Gunduz, Serda; Budama Kilinc, Yasemin; Imhof, Petra; Gok, Bahar; Akman, Gizem; Ozel, Aysen E
one_liner_zh: 该文通过DFT、MD和分子对接研究三肽YKT与DNA的结合机制，属广义蛋白-DNA互作，但对象非TF-DNA体系，方法可迁移，故评6分。
abstract: The main objective of the present study is to investigate the molecular structure and DNA binding interaction of the tyrosyl-lysyl-threonine (YKT) tripeptide, which has anticancer, antioxidant and analgesic properties, using various in silico (MD, QM, molecular docking), spectroscopic (UV, FT-IR, FTIR-ATR, Raman, gel electrophoresis) and in vitro (MCF-7 and HeLa cancer cell lines and BEAS-2B cell line) methods. The optimized geometry, vibrational wavenumbers, molecular electrostatic potential (MEP), natural bond orbital (NBO) and HOMO-LUMO (highest occupied molecular orbital- lowest unoccupied molecular orbital) calculations were carried out with Density Functional Theory (DFT) using B3LYP/6-311++G(d,p) basis set to indicate conformational, vibrational and intramolecular charge transfer characteristics. The assignment of all fundamental theoretical vibration wavenumbers was performed using potential energy distribution analysis (PED). DNA is a significant pharmacological target of drugs in several diseases such as cancer. For this reason, molecular docking calculation was used to elucidate the binding and interaction between YKT tripeptide and DNA at the atomic level. Also, the dynamic behaviors of YKT and DNA was examined using MD simulations. Besides, the interaction of YKT with DNA was experimentally examined by UV titration method and agarose gel electrophoresis method. Experimental results showed that YKT was intercalatively and electrostatically bound to CT-DNA (Calf thymus DNA) and cleavage pBR322 DNA in the presence of H(2)O(2). The pharmacokinetic profile of YKT was also obtained. Cytotoxic effect of YKT was evaluated on MCF-7, HeLa and BEAS-2B cell lines. Hence, these studies about YKT tripeptide may pave the way for the development of various cancer drugs. Communicated by Ramaswamy H. Sarma.
abstract_zh: 本研究的主要目标是利用多种计算机模拟（MD、QM、分子对接）、光谱学（UV、FT-IR、FTIR-ATR、Raman、凝胶电泳）和体外（MCF-7和HeLa癌细胞系以及BEAS-2B细胞系）方法，研究具有抗癌、抗氧化和镇痛特性的酪氨酰-赖氨酰-苏氨酸（YKT）三肽的分子结构及其与DNA的结合相互作用。采用密度泛函理论（DFT）B3LYP/6-311++G(d,p)基组进行了优化几何结构、振动波数、分子静电势（MEP）、自然键轨道（NBO）和HOMO-LUMO（最高占据分子轨道-最低未占分子轨道）计算，以揭示构象、振动和分子内电荷转移特性。所有基本理论振动波数的归属通过势能分布分析（PED）完成。DNA是多种疾病（如癌症）中药物的重要药理学靶点。为此，利用分子对接计算在原子水平上阐明了YKT三肽与DNA之间的结合和相互作用。同时，通过MD模拟考察了YKT和DNA的动态行为。此外，通过UV滴定法和琼脂糖凝胶电泳法实验检测了YKT与DNA的相互作用。实验结果表明，YKT以嵌入和静电方式结合到CT-DNA（小牛胸腺DNA），并在H(2)O(2)存在下切割pBR322 DNA。还获得了YKT的药代动力学特征。评估了YKT对MCF-7、HeLa和BEAS-2B细胞系的细胞毒性效应。因此，这些关于YKT三肽的研究可能为多种癌症药物的开发铺平道路。由Ramaswamy H. Sarma通讯。
